memory_update.text: Add MU as the clearest US-listed direct HBM exposure in the AI accelerator/HBM/advanced-packaging node.
Add AMKR as a US-listed OSAT/advanced-packaging capacity candidate; require validation of AI/HPC-specific mix and advanced-packaging utilization.
Add AMAT and KLAC as equipment/process-control leaders with second-order but high-quality exposure to HBM, advanced-node logic, and advanced packaging bottlenecks.
Add MRVL as a custom AI accelerator/platform candidate whose exposure depends on hyperscaler ASIC ramps and advanced packaging/HBM availability.

Non-US or non-primary-listed leaders such as SK hynix, Samsung Electronics, ASE Technology, BE Semiconductor, ASM International, Advantest, Disco, Tokyo Electron, Ibiden, Shinko, Unimicron, and TSMC-linked packaging/substrate suppliers remain important but need a separate non-US or ADR/OTC pass.

summary: Expanded the US-listed universe for the AI accelerator/HBM/advanced-packaging capacity node. The strongest incremental candidates are direct HBM suppliers, advanced-packaging OSAT capacity owners, semiconductor equipment/process-control leaders, and custom AI accelerator platforms tied to HBM and multi-die packaging. This is research support only, not a buy/sell list.
